You are an AI assistant that converts meeting transcripts into structured Meeting Minutes. Extract key information including title, date, attendees, agenda items, decisions made, action items with assignees, and next meeting details. 
This is a structured meeting transcript with explicit metadata sections.
Extract information as usual from the clearly marked sections.
ONLY extract information that is explicitly present in the transcript.
DO NOT generate or infer information that is not present in the transcript.
 Respond ONLY with valid JSON in the following format: {"title": "Meeting Title", "date": "Meeting Date", "attendees":[{"name": "Attendee Name", "role": "Attendee Role"}], "agenda":["Formal Agenda Item 1", "Formal Agenda Item 2"], "decisions":["Decision 1", "Decision 2"], "action_items":[{"task": "Task Description", "assignee": "Assignee Name"}], "next_meeting": "Next meeting details"}. ONLY include information that is explicitly present in the transcript. Distinguish between formal agenda items (usually numbered) and discussion topics. For action items, only include those with clear ownership/assignment.

Please convert the following meeting transcript into structured Meeting Minutes in JSON format:

MINUTES OF THE 4th Annual General Meeting BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING OF Cognitbotz HELD ON Monday, THE 2025-11-03 COMMENCED AT 02:55 AND CONCLUDED AT 02:55, AT Adani Corporate House, Shantigram, Near Vaishno Devi Circle, S. G. Highway, Khodiyar, Ahmedabad - 382421, Gujarat, India

The following Directors were present:
                

In ATTENDANCE: – 


Chairman 

Mr. Anup Pravin Shah occupied the Chair and the meeting commenced its business.

LEAVE OF ABSENCE: 

All directors being present, there is no requirement to grant leave of absence.

QUORUM:

The Chairman assessed the quorum for commencement of the proceeding of the board Meeting of the Company. For this the attendance register was circulated among the members of the board for their signature in token of their presence. After that the Chairman declared that a valid quorum is present in the meeting and commenced the proceedings.


TO CONFIRM THE MINUTES OF THE PREVIOUS BOARD MEETING.

The Chairman placed on table the minutes of the previous meeting of Board of Directors dated  which were prepared within the stipulated time period. The same were read, confirmed and approved by the Board and signed by the Chairman of the meeting.    

TO REVIEW BUSINESS OPERATIONS OF THE COMPANY. 

The Board was informed about the status of business activities of the Company.
 
The Board discussed the same and took note of it. 

VOTE OF THANKS:

Thereafter there being no other business the meeting terminated with a vote of thanks to the chair.

Date of Recording    :  2025-11-17
Date of Signing	:   2025-11-18	
Place			:   Adani Corporate House, Shantigram, Near Vaishno Devi Circle, S. G. Highway, Khodiyar, Ahmedabad - 382421, Gujarat, India				Chairman  

IMPORTANT: Respond ONLY with valid JSON. Do not include any other text, markdown, or explanations. ONLY include information that is explicitly present in the transcript. Distinguish between formal agenda items (usually numbered) and discussion topics. For action items, only include those with clear ownership/assignment.
